scope: One confirmed facet in one explicitly defined proposal. Both contexts use the same ordinal predicates; hypothetical assumptions change the meaning, not the numeric table.

acceptance.rejects: Rejects this aspect as specified in THIS proposal.
acceptance.conditional: Would accept only after a further change not included in THIS proposal.
acceptance.balanced: Willingness and material reservations without clear acceptance.
acceptance.cautious: Accepts with caution or limited reservations.
acceptance.clear: Clearly accepts/supports this aspect; a brief answer or choice can establish this.
acceptance.endorsement: Citizen explicitly endorses this aspect without reservations, not merely Yes/agreement or model wording.
acceptance.unknown: No evaluable position or inconsistent evidence.

objection.categorical: Explicit categorical refusal of the specified aspect despite all acceptable modifications; takes precedence over a personal boundary. Removing the aspect does not make it acceptable.
objection.strong_disruption: Strong concrete disruption requiring substantial mitigation.
objection.none: No remaining objection to this aspect is expressed.
objection.unknown: Intensity or relevant meaning cannot be established.

highest_criterion: Explicit unqualified citizen-authored endorsement of the specific aspect, without remaining requirements, independently checked. Review citizen-authored score-8 answers as well as score-9 answers; if endorsement was overlooked, request a bounded LLM numerical reassessment rather than substitute a Python score. Other-aspect objections, brevity and lack of technical vocabulary do not disqualify endorsement. Bare agreement and applicability confirmations are insufficient. A proposed 9 rejected by the independent criterion check receives a bounded LLM numerical reassessment below 9, preserving actual reservations; Python does not substitute the number. If a bounded 8/9 reassessment still supplies a valid 8, preserve that LLM-assigned clear acceptance and audit the unresolved endorsement strength; do not erase the facet or substitute 9.
uncertainty: No neutral substitute. Inconsistent/missing descriptions return null with clarification.
reuse: Explicit unchanged applicability and equivalent construct, facet position, conditions and policy. Preserve the source decision and testimony; reuse is not a new endorsement.
facet_combination: Minimum independently anchored clear relevant facets, once per concern. Unknown required modified facets make that concern unavailable.
